text: The rite of conversion was performed at the Trinity Cathedral
The traditional rite of transfiguration was performed at the Cathedral of the Holy Trinity. The service symbolically depicts the burial and mourning of the crucified Jesus Christ.
The ritual was performed today by the Patriarchal Enthronement, Metropolitan Shio (Mujiri) of Senaki and Chkhorotsku, together with the hierarchs.
Today is Good Friday, the most solemn day of Holy Week. The Orthodox Church commemorates the crucifixion, removal from the cross, and burial of Jesus Christ.

On Good Friday, no services are held in churches, because, according to the Gospel, the Lord offered himself as a sacrifice to redeem people from their sins. During the service, the Holy Hour is completed, during which the Gospel of the Lord's Passion is read.
Believers dye eggs red on this day and also bake Easter cakes, because, according to the Gospel, the crucifixion of Jesus Christ took place on the Jewish holiday of Passover.
